_comment: Whitelist packaging config. Nothing is included unless it is named here.
This is deliberate: the source folder also contains procurement documents,
invoices, and third-party video that must never reach a published bundle.
A blacklist would eventually miss one of them; a whitelist cannot.

_not_published._comment: Deliberately outside the release. Recorded here so the reasoning is not lost, and so nobody re-adds them without reading why.
_not_published.hand_gestures_and_costume_images: จีบ*/วง*/ตั้งวง/ล่อแก้ว and tha79-86, 14184-BIG, 9-4, 470191295_* — outside the agreed scope, and the provenance of several is unconfirmed (at least one is a Facebook image)
_not_published.book_scans: โนราคล้ายขี้หนอน/ — copyright not yet confirmed; needs the book title and year of publication
_not_published.controlmaps_and_overlays: nora_pipeline_output/controlmaps, overlays — derived working files, outside the agreed scope
_not_published.pipeline_code: colab_*.py, gemini_*.py, rig_extraction/ — outside the agreed scope for this release
_not_published.tiktok_sourced_video: snaptik_*.mp4 and roi_wilor_overlay*.mp4 — third-party content, must not be redistributed
_not_published.facebook_derived_keypoints: nora_pipeline_output/keypoints/orig_*.json and cost_470191295_*.json — filenames are Facebook photo IDs. The same IDs are embedded as pose_id values inside pose_library.json, manifest.json and manifest.csv, so those three are rewritten at packaging time by the drop_out_of_scope record filter rather than copied.
_not_published.keypoints_of_unpublished_images: nora_pipeline_output/keypoints/hand_*.json and cost_*.json — coordinates extracted from the hand-gesture and costume images above. The images are outside the release, so their coordinates are too.
_not_published.procurement: TOR*.docx, .bak_TOR*, dreamina-invoice/, หลักฐานราคากลาง/ — internal documents
